Most of our graduates choose to continue to postgraduate study, in Italy or abroad, with a Master programme in Accounting, Banking and Finance, International Management or similar fields. Thanks to a 4+1 Programme agreement with the New York University's Business School, our graduates will be given favourable consideration in the admissions process to gain a Master of Science in Accounting.

unibz is part of SUNRISE, a European alliance of nine small and medium-sized universities located in non-metropolitan regions. The alliance promotes cooperation with businesses and local stakeholders, expanding education, mobility, research and innovation, with a particular focus on STEAM subjects.

Besides teaching and research, another fundamental objective of unibz - the so called third mission - is to contribute to the economic, social and cultural development of our territory through collaborations with public institutions and private organisations.
